Tedit\'s terminal, Run and language servers can use Debian 13 (trixie). It runs through VHDP without root: programs inside see themselves as root but have only LX\'s permissions on this device. They can read LX\'s own files too, so install only packages you trust.
apt, pip and npm inside Debian download from their own servers when you run them. Debian looks up names through 8.8.8.8 and 1.1.1.1.
Everything you install with apt stays in %1$s, in LX\'s own storage. Your files in internal storage and the open folder appear inside Debian at the same path.

This is dracxterm\'s terminal. With Debian set up it runs bash in Debian through VHDP as dracxterm\'s user dracos, with sudo for commands that need root; before that it runs BusyBox\'s shell, or Android\'s sh on a phone that refuses BusyBox. Every shell runs as LX, with LX\'s permissions and no real root. Full-screen programs such as nano, vi and top work. Long-press to select and copy, pinch to change the text size.
